Class LogisticCore

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.solver.LogisticCore
Direct Known Subclasses:
LogisticCoreAdd, LogisticCoreMult
public abstract class LogisticCore extends Object
Implements the core Logistic Sampling algorithm by calling the required stationary point calculations, Hessian calculations, and the correct integration scheme for solution of the model, to calculate the NC. See Ong 2018. Subclassed by the additive and multiplicative core, which are responsible for choosing the correct logistic functions for use by the core algorithm
